ScopedApiKeys.Description: Admin key (all scopes) — set via environment variable
Read-only key (Viewer role) — set via environment variable

EasyAuth.Description: Azure App Service Easy Auth. X-MS-CLIENT-PRINCIPAL-ID is only trusted when Azure Easy Auth is detected on the worker (WEBSITE_AUTH_ENABLED=True). On non-Azure hosts the header is ignored unless TrustClientPrincipalHeader is explicitly true AND your front end strips and injects it.

Oidc.Description: Provider-neutral per-user SSO for any OIDC identity provider (Entra ID, Okta, Auth0, Ping, Google Workspace, ...) — works on any host, unlike EasyAuth above which is Azure App Service only. Off by default: set Enabled=true plus your IdP's Authority and this app's Audience (client ID) to accept 'Authorization: Bearer <JWT>' requests as per-user identities.

Retention.Description: Off by default — audit logs are kept forever unless you opt in. Set Enabled=true to automatically purge entries older than RetentionDays on a background sweep (every SweepIntervalHours). An on-demand purge is also available via POST /api/v1/audit/purge for enforcing a tightened policy immediately.

SecurityHeaders.ContentSecurityPolicyProduction: default-src 'self'; script-src 'self'; style-src 'self' 'unsafe-inline'; img-src 'self' data:; font-src 'self'; connect-src 'self'; frame-ancestors 'none'
SecurityHeaders.PermissionsPolicy: accelerometer=(), camera=(), geolocation=(), gyroscope=(), magnetometer=(), microphone=(), payment=(), usb=()
